description: Read historical financial statements for one exact Bullrun ticker, with growth/CAGR consistency checks first, then income, balance sheet, cash flow, per-share metrics, margins and source currency. Defaults to a five-fiscal-year window of annual rows; request years=1-15 and periodType=quarterly or both for more detail. Use for growth consistency, margins, leverage and cash-flow quality; read the period/currency coverage before comparing.

includeEmptyRows.description: Include sparse rows that have no major income statement, balance sheet, cash-flow, or EPS values.

periodType.description: Defaults to annual statements with a growth summary. Choose quarterly or both for detailed period research. Annual rows use fiscalQuarter=0.

ticker.description: The Bullrun ticker. Use the listing ticker returned by search_stocks. US/European examples: AAPL, BMW, NESN. Most Asian listings keep their exchange suffix (6324.T, 0700.HK); some use bare codes (005930). Native or suffixed forms resolve only when one listing matches; search by company name or ISIN if unsure.

years.description: Fiscal-year window counting backward from the latest available fiscal year. Default 5; request up to 15 for longer research.

name: get_financial_history
title: Get financial history
